title: Central Services Medical Attendance (CSMA) Rules Policy Document

nodes.title: 1. Overview & Objectives
nodes.content: Medical attendance/reimbursement framework for eligible Central Government employees and specified beneficiaries where CGHS coverage does not apply.

nodes.title: 2. Eligibility Criteria
nodes.content: Eligible Central Government employees and covered family members under CSMA rules and applicable department/location conditions.

nodes.title: 3. Benefits & Coverage
nodes.content: Financial assistance and healthcare benefits provided under Central Services Medical Attendance (CSMA) Rules.

nodes.title: 4. Required Documents & Application Process
nodes.content: Aadhaar Card, Income Certificate, Ration Card, and Bank Account details.
